change: Compact tab/pane panel and floating-overlay inspection
behavior: Single compact header for Tabs/Panes/counts and Close replaces duplicate headings. Rows are at least 56 dp with smaller vector stacks and 4 dp gaps. Open/split actions share a 48 dp footer row. Floating panes retain real rectangles and z-order with translucent fill and dashed borders. Hide/Show floating affects only map visibility; underlying tiled panes become reachable by touch, and floating panes remain in the full list. Selection, explicit navigation and server resources are unchanged by visibility toggles.
